---

## Ingredients

- 1 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup powdered sugar (crust)
- 2 cups all-purpose flour, divided
- 1/4 tsp kosher salt
- 4 large eggs
- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
- 2/3 cup fresh lemon juice
- 1 tbsp lemon zest
- Powdered sugar, for dusting

## Steps

1. Heat the oven to 350°F. Line an 8x8 pan with parchment.
2. Mix butter, powdered sugar, 1 3/4 cups flour, and salt. Press into the pan. Bake 18 minutes.
3. Whisk eggs, sugar, remaining flour, lemon juice, and zest. Pour over the hot crust.
4. Bake 20 to 22 minutes until just set. Cool, chill, dust, and cut.
